name: Usopp
description: A slingshot sniper who trades heavy shots, rapid volleys, or precision range against a modest base attack. This is a first design draft inspired by Usopp, not a canonical ability catalog.

upgrades.name: Dense Pellets
upgrades.description: Heavier ammunition passes through one more target.

upgrades.name: Reinforced Sling
upgrades.description: A stronger draw adds two pierce.

upgrades.name: Heavy Shot
upgrades.description: Each pellet deals one more damage.

upgrades.name: Hammer Pellet
upgrades.description: Dense ammunition adds two damage and three pierce.

upgrades.name: Siege Sling
upgrades.description: A heavy final shot adds four damage and four pierce.

upgrades.name: Rapid Reload
upgrades.description: Reload time falls by another 20 percent.

upgrades.name: Triple Pellet
upgrades.description: Fire three pellets in a spread.

upgrades.name: Barrage
upgrades.description: Reload time falls by another 25 percent.

upgrades.name: Slingstorm
upgrades.description: Fire five pellets with another 20 percent faster reload.

upgrades.name: Watchful Eye
upgrades.description: Add four range and detect camouflaged targets.

upgrades.name: Sniper Sling
upgrades.description: Add ten range and one damage.

upgrades.name: Distant Mark
upgrades.description: Add eight range and one damage.

upgrades.name: Sogeking Shot
upgrades.description: Add ten range and three damage.
